existing_18_case_audit.untouched_baseline_confirmation: All 16 approved MVP cases (EV-001..EV-016), 2 Post-MVP B-003 drafts (EV-017..EV-018), 6 isolated negative fixtures (NEG-001..NEG-006), manifest.json, and schemas/*.json remain completely unmodified.
confirmed_gaps_found: Gap 1 (EV-002): EV-002 emits DIRECT_COMMIT CANDIDATE on NO_MATCH_OBSERVED, but has no semantic expectation that NO_MATCH_OBSERVED != 'definitely no PR' and requires user association confirmation.

Gap 2 (Default branch & PR dedup): All 18 cases use default_branch='main'; 0 cases test provider-reported 'trunk'/'master' vs non-default branch (including branch literally named 'main'), squash/rebase PR deduplication, out-of-window PR association suppressing direct-commit duplication on an otherwise eligible in-window commit, or rejection of timestamp/message similarity heuristics.

Gap 3 (Active Event CANNOT_LINK): EV-013 tests non-Event IDs and EV-014 tests nesting/inactive members; 0 cases test an explicit CANNOT_LINK relation between two active, same-workspace, same-repo, version-matched Events failing solely with CANNOT_LINK_CONFLICT.

Gap 4 (Keep/Edit tracking): Audit of user_commands across EV-001..EV-018 found ONLY split, manual_merge, exclude, and dissolve; 0 cases test MVP API §5 POST /work-events/{id}/actions/confirm or PATCH /work-events/{id}, Event Guide §6 new CANDIDATE version on edit, DB Model domain ReviewAction CONFIRM/EDIT, or edit vs merge separation.
